stance: Access and identity discovery is shifting from passive conventions into strict cryptographic verification, even as major operators retain unilateral control by prioritizing bespoke bot directives over standardized opt-out signals.
adoption_shape: Infrastructure tooling led by Cloudflare is aggressively implementing and hardening IETF Web Bot Auth specifications—banning HMAC and requiring draft-00 parameters—while AI operators like Anthropic adopt opt-out frameworks like IETF aipref only on the condition that their specific robots.txt directives take precedence.
new_entrants: Anthropic entered the browser execution layer with Claude-Agent for Claude Duet, establishing automated multi-step task execution across sites, while new IETF contributors are seeking to standardize bot identity through the proposed Signed-Agent-Metadata HTTP header.
watch_for: Whether upstream Go HTTP message signature libraries resolve the dictionary member parsing bug that currently impedes native Signature-Agent validation under draft-ietf-webbotauth-httpsig-protocol-00.
